The end cards are not done: 35, 38 and 77 each scored 3 from the critic, and 4 is the pass mark. I shipped nothing this run.

I re-shot 35, 38, 40, 59, 60, 76 and 77, but only ran the critic on 35, 38 and 77. The scores for 40, 59, 60 and 76 are carried over from earlier runs. Those were 40=3, 59=3, 60=3 and 76=2 (76 has only the older 13-c6 score).

What still holds the three cards below 4:
- **`$` hero figure:** the critic flags it on every card because the guide says score is SP. The game uses `$` for credits and the haul total everywhere. I left it, and the question is already in `questions.md`.
- **Dev-style controls:** a close X, a key-hint strip and the "Copy report" button. Changing them would reverse buttons he already set, so I left them.
- **Small grey text:** too many tiers of it above the item tiles. I judged no safe change would lift the score without his answer on `$` vs SP.

When he answers the `$` question, the hero swap should go first. It is the one finding shared by 35, 38, 60 and 77. I wrote this up in `tools/handoff/console/notes/ui/end-cards.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: 35, 38 and 77 sit at 3, and the remaining fixes wait on his answer about `$` vs SP and the dev controls (close X, key-hint strip, "Copy report").
